summary: Adopt the company-reporter role into the Hermes template with a least-privilege runtime contract: delta save mode, disabled toolsets, no_mcp platform toolsets, spawn depth 1, no MCP inheritance, no .env inheritance, and no systemd gateway install.
Run secret-scan.py against the rendered runtime scaffold before it is copied into the runtime, and guard that provisioning never resurrects a per-agent runtime remote.

Delete 33GOD/codex/company-reporter rather than merge it: the generated reporter profile is regenerable, its scrum-master tooling was renamed to sentinel upstream, its sentinel runner was superseded by heartbeat.sh, and it carried a tracked runtime submodule that FR4 forbids.
